# Chapter 4 - Physics {#sec-physics}

This page describes the models behind the simulation. The models come from
the SQF implementations.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Determinism

Core atmospheric state is a pure function of position, mission time, and
engine weather. Event rolls (lightning, microburst, space weather) use a
seeded linear congruential generator, so every machine in a multiplayer
session computes the same values.
:::

## Solar radiation and temperature

Temperature follows the sun: the diurnal curve is driven by solar elevation,
computed from the day of year, local hour, and world latitude. Cloud cover
transmits 25% of radiation at full overcast.

- Elevation lapse rate: 0.0065 C per metre.
- Overcast cooling: 4 C per unit.
- Surface-type modifiers: desert +4, sand +2, ice -5, snow -3, coniferous -2,
  forest -1.5.
- Wind chill: JAG/TTI formula, valid below 10 C and above 4.8 km/h wind.

## The water cycle

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    P[Precipitation] --> S[Soil moisture]
    S --> E[Evaporation]
    E --> H[Relative humidity]
    H --> C[Cloud]
    C --> P
```

Rain soaks the ground. Temperature and wind dry it. Moist soil raises the
relative humidity. The state variable is `aee_core_soilMoisture` (0..1).

## Air density

Buck 1996: saturation vapour pressure
`e_s = 6.1121 * exp((18.678 - T/234.5) * T/(257.14 + T))`, actual vapour
pressure `e = e_s * RH / 100`, virtual temperature
`T_v = T_K / (1 - 0.37802 * e / P)`, density
`rho = P_Pa / (R_d * T_v)` with `R_d = 287.05287`.

## WBGT

Heat index uses the Stull 2011 wet-bulb approximation with the globe
temperature interpolated between sun and shade by overcast.

::: {.callout-note}
## SQF atan returns degrees

The Stull formula expects radians. Every atan term is converted with the
degree-to-radian factor 0.0174532925. Getting this wrong produced WBGT values
near 973 C.
:::

## Biome

Koppen classification, 18 codes. Resolution order: map-name match
(Stratis = Csa, Tanoa = Af, Enoch = Dfb), CfgWorlds description keywords,
surface-type and latitude voting, then the oceanic fallback Cfb.

## Sea state and tide

Beaufort scale with wave height and a tidal offset and description.

## Events

Lightning, microburst, sandstorm, dust devil, blowing snow, avalanche,
flash flood, and space weather (solar flares, aurora) roll on deterministic
chances. Thunder follows the flash after a fixed sound-travel delay.

| Surface | Modifier (C) |
|---|---|
| Desert | +4 |
| Sand | +2 |
| Ice | -5 |
| Snow | -3 |
| Coniferous | -2 |
| Forest | -1.5 |

## Wind chill

Wind chill uses the JAG/TTI formula. It is valid when temperature is at or
below 10 C and wind speed is above 4.8 km/h.

```
Twc = 13.12 + 0.6215*T - 11.37*(V*3.6)^0.16 + 0.3965*T*(V*3.6)^0.16
```

`T` is the air temperature in Celsius. `V` is the wind speed in metres per
second.

## Air density

Air density uses the Buck 1996 model. Saturation vapour pressure is:

```
e_s = 6.1121 * exp((18.678 - T/234.5) * T / (257.14 + T))
```

Actual vapour pressure is `e = e_s * RH / 100`. Virtual temperature is:

```
T_v = T_K / (1 - 0.37802 * e / P)
```

Density is `rho = P_Pa / (R_d * T_v)`. The gas constant `R_d` is
287.05287 J/(kg*K).

## Humidity

Relative humidity uses diurnal modulation.

## Pressure

Pressure is barometric. The model uses pressure trend readings
(`pressureReading1` and `pressureReading2`) and the ICAO reference altitude.

## Biome classification

Biome uses the Koppen classification. The 18 codes are `Af`, `Am`, `Aw`,
`BWh`, `BWk`, `BSh`, `BSk`, `Csa`, `Csb`, `Cfa`, `Cfb`, `Cwa`, `Dfa`, `Dfb`,
`Dfc`, `ET`, and `EF`.

The model resolves the biome in this order:

1. Match the map name first. Stratis and Altis resolve to `Csa`.
2. Match `CfgWorlds` description keywords.
3. Use surface type and latitude weighted voting.
4. Fall back to `Cfb`.

## WBGT

Wet bulb globe temperature (WBGT) drives heat stress in the physiology
addon.

## Sea state

Sea state uses the Beaufort scale. The model tracks wave height and tide
prediction, including the tide offset and description.

## Radio propagation

Radio propagation covers the VHF, UHF, and HF bands. Atmospheric effects
modify the propagation.

## Events

The event system covers lightning, microburst, dust devil, sandstorm,
blowing snow, avalanche, flash flood, space weather, freeze-thaw, and frost
on windscreens. Space weather includes solar flares and aurora.

## Deterministic multiplayer

Core atmospheric state is a pure function of position, mission time, and
engine weather. Every machine computes identical values. No
`publicVariable` is needed. Event FX vary cosmetically per machine.
